result:
All 14 queries ran and gave sensible answers on the input files. I didn't cross-check them against the data by hand. I ended R6 and R14 with `keyword` so their results are strings, not keywords. In R9 and R4 the object keys print as keywords, which is how qlang shows map keys.

R1: filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~(at :address | if (eq null) ~(false) ~(at :city | coalesce "" | lower | eq "berlin")) * /name | sort
R2: filter ~(at :age | type | eq ::number) * /age | avg | round 2
R3: filter ~(/status | eq "paid") | groupBy ~(/customer) * (* (at :items | coalesce [] * mulOf /qty /price | sum) | sum | round 2)
R4: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | groupBy ~(at :assignee | coalesce {} | at :login | coalesce "unassigned") * count
R5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 * /number
R6: [/dependencies /devDependencies] * entries | flat | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") * (/0 | keyword) | distinct | sort
R7: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) * split " " | filter ~(/3 | parseJson | gte 500) * /2 | distinct | sort
R8: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) * split " " | filter ~(/1 | eq "GET") * (/4 | split "ms" | /0 | parseJson) | avg | round 0
R9: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) * split "," | filter ~(/2 | ne "") | groupBy ~(/1) * (* (/2 | parseJson) | avg | round 1)
R10: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) * (split "," | /3) | filter ~(ne "") * split ";" | flat * lower | distinct | sort
R11: lines * trim | filter ~(count | gt 0) | filter ~(startsWith "DB_") * (:s / | [(s | split "=" | /0 | trim | drop 3 | lower | keyword) (s | split "=" | drop 1 | join "=" | trim)]) | tag ::map
R12: /services | entries | filter ~(/1 | at :enabled | eq true) * (:e / | {:name (/0 | print | drop 1) :url (e | /1 | [/protocol "://" /host ":" (at :port | coalesce 80 | print)] | join "")}) | sort ~(/name)
R13: :ev / | filter ~(/type | eq "purchase") | :p / | {:total (* (at :meta | coalesce {} | at :amount | coalesce 0) | sum | round 2) :users (* /user | distinct | count) :hasRefund (ev | any ~(/type | lower | eq "refund"))}
R14: ["Apple","banana","apple","Cherry","BANANA","date","Elder","cherry","fig","Apple"] * lower | groupBy ~() | filter ~(count | gt 1) | keys * keyword | sort
